Iyakokin nauyin kwatance su ne 18.5 × 1.75² = 56.65625 kg da 25 × 1.75² = 76.5625 kg; ba a haɗa iyakar sama ba. Bayan zagaye domin nunawa: 56.7–<76.6 kg. Wannan kayan ilimi na manya ba ya zaɓar nauyin da za a yi amfani da shi wajen ƙayyade magani a asibiti, ba ya lissafa adadin magani, kuma ba ya ƙayyade nauyin lafiya da za a nema. For a₁x + b₁y = c₁ and a₂x + b₂y = c₂, D: Ga a₁x + b₁y = c₁ da a₂x + b₂y = c₂, D = a₁b₂ − a₂b₁. Idan D ≠ 0, x = (c₁b₂ − c₂b₁) ÷ D da y = (a₁c₂ − a₂c₁) ÷ D. Idan D = 0, sharuddan da suka dogara da juna kuma suka dace suna da mafita marasa iyaka; sharuddan da suka saba wa juna ba su da mafita. A polynomial of degree 2 has two roots c: Polynomial mai degree 2 yana da tushen biyu idan an ƙirga maimaituwar tushe. Suna iya zama tushe ɗaya da ya maimaitu ko kuma complex pair; idan an ƙirga maimaituwa, koyaushe guda biyu ne.
x = [−b ± √(b² − 4ac)] ÷ 2a. The discrim: x = [−b ± √(b² − 4ac)] ÷ 2a. Discriminant D = b² − 4ac yana tantance nau’in tushen: D > 0 yana ba da real roots biyu daban, D = 0 yana ba da tushe ɗaya mai maimaituwa, D < 0 yana ba da complex roots biyu. Ƙimar x ta vertex ita ce x = −b ÷ 2a.
It is the parabola's turning point: the: Shi ne vertex na parabola: mafi ƙarancin ƙima idan a > 0, mafi girman ƙima idan a < 0. Ƙimar x ɗinsa tana daidai a tsakiyar real roots biyu idan suna akwai.
Uniform independent hashes only. Up to 1: Wannan ƙididdiga ta shafi hash masu zaman kansu da rarrabuwar yiwuwar iri ɗaya kawai. Har zuwa hash 10,000, ana lissafa ninkin yiwuwar rashin karo a sararin log; ga adadi mafi girma, ana amfani da kimanta ranar haihuwa. Idan adadin hash ya fi adadin sakamakon da zai yiwu, tabbas za a samu karo. Wannan ba hujjar tsaron kriptografi ba ce kuma ba samfurin karo da maharin ya haddasa ba ne.

With N equal-size disks of S TB, usable: Ga faifai N masu girma iri ɗaya, kowanne S TB, ƙarfin da za a iya amfani da shi shi ne NS a RAID0, S a RAID1, (N−1)S a RAID5, (N−2)S a RAID6, da NS/2 a RAID10. Kariyar ƙarin faifai ba ta maye gurbin kwafin ajiya ba.
Use FFMI = W(1−f)/h². W is body mass in: Yi amfani da FFMI = W(1−f)/h². W shi ne nauyin jiki a kg, f shi ne kitsen jikin da aka auna a matsayin kaso na adadi, h kuma tsayi ne bayan an sauya shi zuwa m. Ma'aunin yana cikin kg/m².
Use FMI = Wf/h². W is body mass in kg, f: Yi amfani da FMI = Wf/h². W shi ne nauyin jiki a kg, f shi ne kitsen jikin da aka auna a matsayin kaso na adadi, h kuma tsayi ne bayan an sauya shi zuwa m. Ma'aunin yana cikin kg/m².
Use T = n(r+w) and D = n(ra+wb)/60. n is: Yi amfani da T = n(r+w) da D = n(ra+wb)/60. n shi ne yawan zagaye; r da w su ne mintunan gudu da tafiya a kowane zagaye. a da b su ne gudun da ya dace da kowanne a km/h. T yana cikin mintuna, D kuma yana cikin km.
Use N = ceil[(A−O)(1+w)/((l+j)(h+j))]. A: Yi amfani da N = ceil[(A−O)(1+w)/((l+j)(h+j))]. A da O su ne fadin bango da na wuraren bude a m²; l da h girman fuskar bulo ne, j kuma fadin tazarar turmi, duk bayan an sauya su zuwa m. w shi ne kaso na karin kayan asara; ceil yana zagaye adadi zuwa sama.
Use W = Cr. C is coffee mass in g and r: Yi amfani da W = Cr. C shi ne nauyin kofi a g, r kuma gram na ruwa ga kowane gram na kofi. W shi ne nauyin ruwan da ake bukata a g; rabon yana kwatanta ruwa da kofi.
Use S = (fp−eq)D/100. f is fuel litres a: Yi amfani da S = (fp−eq)D/100. f shi ne litar mai, e kuma wutar da aka dauka daga tushen lantarki domin cajin mota a kWh, duk a kowace 100 km; p shi ne farashin mai ga lita, q farashin wuta ga kWh, D kuma nisan shekara a km. S shi ne tanadin kudin makamashi na shekara.
Use P = VI and E = Pt/1000. V is voltage: Yi amfani da P = VI da E = Pt/1000. V shi ne karfin lantarki a V, I shi ne kwararar lantarki a A, t kuma lokacin aiki ne a awanni. Karfin aiki P yana cikin W, makamashin da aka cinye E kuma yana cikin kWh.
Use t = VCfη/P. V is nominal voltage in: Yi amfani da t = VCfη/P. V shi ne karfin lantarki na asali a V, C shi ne damar batir a Ah, f kaso ne na fitarwar da za a iya amfani da ita, η ingancin sauyawa ne a matsayin kaso, P kuma karfin nauyin da bai canzawa a W. Lokacin aiki t yana cikin awanni.
Use P = Pₛ+ρgh. Pₛ is absolute surface p: Yi amfani da P = Pₛ+ρgh. Pₛ shi ne cikakken matsin lamba a saman ruwa a Pa, ρ shi ne yawan nauyin ruwa ga girma a kg/m³, g shi ne hanzarin nauyi a m/s², h kuma zurfi ne a m. Cikakken matsin lamba P yana cikin Pa.
Use P = kAΔT/L. k is conductivity in W/m: Yi amfani da P = kAΔT/L. k shi ne iya gudanar da zafi a W/m·K, A fadi ne a m², ΔT bambancin zafin bangaren zafi da na sanyi ne mai alama a K, L kuma kauri ne a m. Gudun kwararar zafi P yana cikin W.
Use R = v²sin(2θ)/g and t = 2v sinθ/g. v: Yi amfani da R = v²sin(2θ)/g da t = 2v sinθ/g. v shi ne saurin jefawa a m/s, θ kusurwar dagawa ce a digiri, g kuma hanzarin nauyi ne a m/s². Nisan R yana cikin m, lokacin tashi t kuma yana cikin s, idan tsayin farawa da sauka iri daya ne kuma babu juriya ta iska.
Use L = B⁻¹(α/2;k,n−k+1) and U = B⁻¹(1−α: Yi amfani da L = B⁻¹(α/2;k,n−k+1) da U = B⁻¹(1−α/2;k+1,n−k). k shi ne adadin nasarori, n kuma adadin gwaje-gwaje. Idan c shi ne matakin amincewa a matsayin kaso, sa α = 1−c; B⁻¹ shi ne kwantayil na rarrabar beta. Yi amfani da yanayin iyaka k = 0 → L = 0 da k = n → U = 1.

Assumes constant annual consumption and: Ana ɗauka cewa yawan makamashin da ake amfani da shi a shekara da farashin wutar lantarki ba sa canzawa. Lokacin dawo da kuɗin saye ya dogara da ajiyar kuɗin makamashi kawai; ba a haɗa gyara, kuɗin lamuni, sake sayarwa da tsawon rayuwar na'urar ba.
Uses internal rectangular dimensions and: Ana amfani da ma'aunin cikin tafki mai siffar murabba'i mai kusurwa huɗu da bene mai gangara iri ɗaya. Ba a lissafta matakala, kujerun cikin tafki, bango mai lanƙwasa ko sauyin matakin ruwa ba.
Assumes constant total emitter flow and: Ana ɗauka cewa jimlar ruwan da dukkan masu ɗigon ruwa ke fitarwa da ingancin ban ruwa da aka shigar ba sa canzawa. Kai ne ka zaɓi zurfin ruwan da ake nema; ba a tantance buƙatun amfanin gona, halin ƙasa ko yanayi ba.
Uses the product seed rate and pack mass: Ana amfani da adadin iri a kowace faɗin ƙasa da nauyin kowace jaka da ka shigar, tare da ƙarin adadi na zaɓi saboda asara. Ba a zaɓar nau'in iri, lokacin shuka ko adadin iri da ya dace da aikin gona ba.
